title: HOKA Kodiak Ultra Marathons by UTMB returns for a second edition as a UTMB World Series Major
claims: The 2026 event was the 13th edition and the second as a UTMB World Series Major in the Americas, held from 8 to 11 October 2026.
The organiser expected nearly 2,700 participants and six race formats: 10K, 20K, 50K, 100K, 100M and a kids' race; 33% of participants were women.
The 2026 Major awarded 210 automatic qualification places for the 2027 UTMB World Series Finals across the 50K, 100K and 100M, gave double Running Stones and carried 20 anti-doping tests.

verification.note: 2026-11-09 直接抓取 UTMB 官方赛前新闻稿。
